questions.question: Why is order 1042 late, and what should support do about it?

admin.answer:
Order 1042 (Cobalt Bay Distribution) is on hold for address verification: the carrier could not confirm the delivery address. It was promised for 2026-10-21, so it is 7 days late.

Support should ask the customer to confirm the address and a site contact; the hold normally clears within 2 business days of their reply. Don't promise a new delivery date until the hold is cleared.

args.sql: SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer, o.status, o.hold_reason, o.promised_by FROM orders_v o JOIN customers_v c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id = 1042

detail.sql: SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer, o.status, o.hold_reason, o.promised_by FROM orders_v AS o JOIN customers_v AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id = 1042 LIMIT 50

passages.text: The delivery address could not be confirmed by the carrier, usually because the site has a new loading dock or a missing unit number. Support asks the customer to confirm the address and a site contact; the hold is normally cleared within 2 business days of their reply.

args.query: what support does about a held order

passages.section: Support Playbook: Order Issues > Held orders
passages.text: Look up the order's hold_reason and follow the matching section of the shipping policy. Never promise a new delivery date until the hold is cleared; a hold on credit_check or export_license is outside support's control.

The order is paused and will not move to the next status until the hold is cleared. Every on_hold order has a hold_reason; the shipping policy describes each reason and how to resolve it. An order on hold past its promised delivery date counts as late.
When an order is put on hold, it gets exactly one hold_reason. The promised date is not moved automatically.
The card or bank transfer for the order was declined. The order is held for up to 7 days for the customer to update payment, then cancelled.

passages.section: Support Playbook: Order Issues > Late orders
passages.text: When an order passes its promised date without being delivered, support emails the customer the same day with the current status and a new estimate. For Platinum-tier accounts the account manager also calls.

questions.question: Which on-hold orders are past their promised date, and what does each hold reason mean?

admin.answer:
Two on-hold orders are past their promised date.

**1042**, promised 2026-10-21, is held for address verification: the carrier could not confirm the delivery address. Support asks the customer to confirm it, and the hold normally clears within 2 business days of their reply.

**1044**, promised 2026-10-22, is held for an export licence: EU orders of the PR-900 need one because of its battery capacity. Licences take 5 to 10 business days, and the order ships as soon as one is granted.

args.sql: SELECT o.id, o.status, o.delivered_at, p.model FROM orders_v o JOIN order_items_v i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN products_v p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE o.id = 1074

passages.text: Every Pallet-runner is covered for 24 months from delivery against defects in parts and workmanship, including the battery. Wheels and bumpers are wear parts and are covered for 12 months. The warranty does not cover damage from collisions with forklifts or from running outside the rated temperature range.
Warranty repairs are done on site within 5 business days in the West, Central and East regions, and within 10 business days in the EU. Out-of-warranty repairs are quoted before any work starts.

Customers can return undamaged robots within 30 days of delivery for a refund minus a 15% restocking fee. Returns need a return authorisation (RMA) number from support before anything is shipped back. Returned orders are given the status returned once the robots arrive back at Acme.

questions.question: How many orders are late in each region, and what should support tell those customers?

admin.answer:
Six orders are late right now: 2 in East, 2 in West, 1 in Central and 1 in the EU.

Support emails each customer the same day with the current status and a new estimate. For Platinum-tier accounts the account manager also calls.

args.sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM orders_v o JOIN customers_v c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.promised_by < '2026-10-28' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY late_orders DESC, c.region

detail.sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM orders_v AS o JOIN customers_v AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL AND NOT o.status IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.promised_by < '2026-10-28' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY late_orders DESC, c.region LIMIT 50

args.query: what support tells the customer when an order is late

passages.section: Support Playbook: Order Issues > Late orders
passages.text: When an order passes its promised date without being delivered, support emails the customer the same day with the current status and a new estimate. For Platinum-tier accounts the account manager also calls.

Escalate to the logistics lead if an order is more than 5 business days late, if a customer reports a safety incident, or if a Platinum-tier account asks for escalation. The logistics lead responds within 4 business hours.

The promised delivery date (promised_by) is set when the order is placed: the model's lead time plus the region's transit time. An order that is not delivered by its promised date is late, and support contacts the customer proactively.

The order is paused and will not move to the next status until the hold is cleared. Every on_hold order has a hold_reason; the shipping policy describes each reason and how to resolve it. An order on hold past its promised delivery date counts as late.
